title: Reconstruction Deductive Change Order Credit Worksheet
content:
The credit of a deductive change order on a Reconstruction contract is figured from the removed line, read from the deductive proposal awaiting signature: its scope code, the quantity written on it and the unit price written on it.

**1. The two parts of the removal.** The change-order part of the removal is as much of the quantity written on the deductive proposal as the signed change orders of that scope code other than deductive ones added, less the quantity signed deductive change orders of that scope code already removed; the rest of the quantity written is the contract part, which comes off the contract's own scope.

**2. Crediting each part.** The removed line is credited at the change-order part times the credit unit price, without markup, and the contract part is credited at the credit unit price with nothing returned on it, because no change order charged anything on it.

**3. Credit unit price.** The credit unit price is the tier's rate for the scope code, or, for a scope code that has no tier rate, the unit price written on the proposal.

**4. Order of assembly.** The credit is put together in this order: first the removed line; any treatment or cleaning returned on the change-order part is added to it; any overhead and profit returned is applied once to that sum; the contract part's credit is then added; any fixed deduction the removal carries is then subtracted; a result below zero is credited as zero; and only that result is rounded to the cent, half up.

The tier's rate for a scope code is the contract's own agreement rate in the unit price list (drywall, paint, insulation, baseboard, carpet install, vinyl plank install, tile install, cabinet install, carpenter labor, painter labor, dumpster, final cleaning); flooring, cabinet and fixture upgrade lines and material escalation lines have no tier rate.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A deductive proposal removes 500 square feet of paint. Signed additive change orders of paint scope added 320 square feet, and an earlier signed deductive change order of paint scope removed 70 square feet. The paint rate is assumed at $1.20 per square foot.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Added by change orders, less already removed: 320 less 70 | 250 square feet |
| Change-order part: as much of 500 as 250 | 250 square feet |
| Contract part: 500 less 250 | 250 square feet |
| Removed line: 250 times $1.20 | $300.00 |
| Contract part's credit: 250 times $1.20 | $300.00 |
| Credit | $600.00 |

Had the change orders added 600 square feet with nothing removed before, the whole 500 square feet would be the change-order part and the contract part would be nothing.
